items.title: 18.10 Redox Reactions of Transition Metals (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.10 with an added diagram of the electrode potentials used in 18.10.1-18.10.3, printed page 30.

blocks.text: Transition elements kai oxidation states mein reh sakte hain. Koi redox reaction feasible (mumkin) hai ya nahi, yeh half-reactions ke standard electrode potentials (E°) ka muqabla kar ke tay hota hai. Agar poore cell ka potential (E°cell) positive ho to reaction feasible hai.
Practice mein jis species ka E° zyada positive ho woh reduce hoti hai (electrons leti hai), aur jis ka E° zyada negative (kam positive) ho woh oxidize hoti hai (electrons khoti hai).

blocks.alt: Volt ke scale par electrode potentials ki ladder (seerhi): MnO4- + 8H+ + 5e- -> Mn2+ + 4H2O (+1.52 V), Fe3+ + e- -> Fe2+ (+0.77 V), I2 + 2e- -> 2I- (+0.54 V), Cu2+ + e- -> Cu+ (+0.15 V) aur 2CO2 + 2e- -> C2O4 2- (-0.49 V). Oopar ka teer strong oxidising agent ki direction hai.
blocks.caption: Topics 18.10.1 se 18.10.3 ke electrode potentials (is topic ke liye hamari apni drawing; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jitna upar, utna zyada positive E° aur utna strong oxidizing agent; upar wala couple reduce hota hai aur neeche wala oxidize. MnO₄⁻ aur Fe²⁺: E°cell = 1.52 − 0.77 = +0.75 V. Cu²⁺ aur I⁻: E°cell = 0.15 − 0.54 = −0.39 V, phir bhi CuI ke precipitate banne se reaction aage chalta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab (topic 18.10.1) CO₂/C₂O₄²⁻ couple ke liye E° = +0.49 V chhaapti hai; data tables taqreeban −0.49 V dete hain, is liye ladder mein −0.49 V dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Kisi reaction ka E°cell = +0.75 V hai. Kya yeh feasible hai?
blocks.explanation: Haan; positive E°cell ka matlab hai ke reaction standard conditions mein feasible hai.

items: E°cell = E°reduction − E°oxidation; positive ho to reaction feasible.
Zyada positive E° wali species reduce, kam positive wali oxidize hoti hai.
